# Ahmad YT Tutorial

> Official website of the Ahmad YT Tutorial YouTube channel (https://www.youtube.com/@ahmadyttutorial). Every AI video tutorial on the channel has a page here with the exact, tested AI video prompts used to make it, free to copy. Topics: AI video generation (Google Flow, Veo, Sora, Kling, Runway), AI video prompts, YouTube Shorts and faceless YouTube channel growth.

## Main pages
- [All tutorials](https://ahmadyttutorial.com/tutorials): every AI video tutorial with its prompts
- [Articles](https://ahmadyttutorial.com/articles): guides on writing AI video prompts and growing a YouTube channel with AI
- [About](https://ahmadyttutorial.com/about)
- [Contact](https://ahmadyttutorial.com/contact)

## Notes
- Each tutorial lives at /tutorial/{slug}: the video, a description, the tools used, the full prompts and FAQs.
- Each article lives at /articles/{slug}.
- Full URL list: https://ahmadyttutorial.com/sitemap.xml

## For AI agents
- Any page as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`
- JSON search: https://ahmadyttutorial.com/api/tutorials?q={keywords} and ?slug={slug}
- MCP server (read-only, no auth): https://ahmadyttutorial.com/api/mcp — card: https://ahmadyttutorial.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
